Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) Procurement of Seed under 50% Subsidy Pattern Clause 1: Scheme Pattern & Subsidy Framework 1. The procurement and distribution of the requisitioned seed are governed under the approved departme ntal scheme on a 50% Subsidy Pattern. 2. The total contract value is apportioned into two equal components: ○ Departmental Share (50%): Covered under allocated government budget/subsidy funds. ○ Beneficiary / Farmer Share (50%): Recoverable from beneficiary farmers at the time of field distribution. Clause 2: Terms and Schedule of Payment Payment to the successful bidder/supplier shall be regulated strictly on a staggered, milestone basis as ou tlined below: ● Stage 1 (Department Share – 50% of Admissible Invoice Value): ○ The initial 50% of the total billed amount shall be processed and released upon: i. Complete physical receipt of the contracted quantity at designated departmental store(s)/consignee loca tions. ii. Satisfactory physical inspection, verification of lot numbers, seed tags, packaging integrity, and quality c ertification (germination/purity clearance as per Indian Minimum Seed Certification Standards). iii. Proper stock entry into the relevant departmental stock register(s) and generation of the GeM Provision al / Final Consignee Receipt-cum-Acceptance Certificate (CRAC). ● Stage 2 (Farmer Share – Remaining 50% of Invoice Value):

○ The balance 50% amount shall be released to the supplier strictly on a back-to-back realization basis, su bsequent to: i. Complete distribution of seed lots to beneficiary farmers. ii. Full realization, collection, and reconciliation of the 50% farmer contribution into the designated govern ment/departmental account. ○ Waiting / Credit Period: The supplier shall mandatorily agree to a credit/waiting period of up to six (6) m onths from the date of supply or until the culmination of the current cropping/sowing season, whichever is l ater, for the release of this balance 50% payment. Clause 3: Waiver of Interest / No Financial Claim 1. Under no circumstances shall the department/buyer be liable to pay any interest, carrying cost, penalty, bank charges, or late payment surcharge on the deferred 50% (Farmer Share) amount. 2. Fluctuations in farmer turnout, seasonal weather variations, or administrative collection schedules exten ding up to the stipulated 6-month / seasonal window shall not constitute grounds for breach of contract or financial claim by the vendor. Clause 4: Mandatory Bidder Undertaking (Pre-Qualification Condition) 1. Bidders must unconditionally accept the staggered payment terms and the required credit period. 2. Every participating bidder must upload a signed and stamped "Undertaking on Payment Terms & Subsid y Pattern" on their official letterhead (as per Annexure-A) along with their technical bid. 3. Bids submitted without this explicit undertaking or with conditional/counter payment terms shall be decl ared technically non-responsive and summarily rejected. Clause 5: Quality, Shelf-Life & Delivery Timelines 1. Time Essence: Since sowing seasons are strictly time-bound, the supplier must complete delivery within the period specified in the GeM contract. Liquidated damages (LD) as per standard GeM General Terms an d Conditions (GTC) shall apply to unexcused delivery delays. 2. Germination & Purity Guarantee: The seed supplied must possess valid testing reports and retain prescr ibed germination and physical purity standards throughout the active sowing season. . 6. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt.
